financing.description: We fully finance, install, and maintain rooftop solar power stations for apartment complexes and residential communities across Turkey. Homeowners pay zero upfront costs.

card1.title: Zero Upfront Down Payment
card1.desc: No contributions or hidden fees required from property owners or site management.

card2.title: Project Value per Complex
card2.desc: 100% funded and executed by Solar4Turkey depending on facility footprint.

card3.title: Annual Power Cost Reduction
card3.desc: Up to 20% savings during years 1–10, scaling up to 50% savings thereafter.

card4.title: Energy Autonomy & Tariff Lock
card4.desc: Immediate aidat (dues) reduction and long-term protection from rising grid rates.

banner.title: Custom financial models designed around your complex’s exact layout.
banner.desc: Every residential complex has unique common area energy demands (elevators, lighting, pools). We build customized revenue and savings allocation structures suited to your site board’s preferences.

savings.title: Your Benefits with Solar4Turkey System

day.title: Daytime
day.desc: While the sun shines across Turkey, your rooftop works for you — solar panels power your home, charge your EV, and fill your battery to 100%. You pay zero to the grid for daytime energy.

night.title: Nighttime
night.desc: When the sun sets, your battery seamlessly takes over — significantly cutting energy costs for common areas (pools, pumps, sauna, hammam, lighting, ventilation, cameras, etc.) from day one of operation. Complete self-sufficiency even after dark.

savings.disclaimer: * Calculation based on PVGIS irradiance data for Turkey (35° tilt, south-facing), electricity tariff rate of ₺3.50/kWh with tax, and full battery self-consumption. Actual savings depend on regional weather patterns and household consumption habits.

benefits.section_subtitle: Maximum savings, comfort, and zero risk for property owners

list.title: Zero Initial Investment
list.description: Owners do not need to pay for equipment purchases or participate in special targeted collections.

list.title: Savings From Day One
list.description: Once launched, the station immediately begins reducing energy costs consumed by common areas.

list.title: No Loans or Debt
list.description: Residents do not need to take out bank loans or assume financial obligations for expensive equipment.

list.title: Reduction of Aidat Burden
list.description: Electricity expenses are offset by solar generation, helping keep maintenance fees stable.

list.title: Protection Against Tariff Hikes
list.description: The higher future electricity costs rise, the greater the financial benefit from your solar installation.

list.title: Zero Technical Risks
list.description: Full legal and technical responsibility for the equipment rests entirely with Solar4Turkey.

list.title: Free Maintenance
list.description: All scheduled routine maintenance work is carried out at Solar4Turkey's expense.

list.title: Free Panel Cleaning
list.description: Regular panel washing to maintain maximum energy efficiency is included in the agreement.

list.title: Warranty Repairs & Replacement
list.description: In case of equipment failure, all repair and replacement costs are fully covered by Solar4Turkey.

list.title: 24/7 Continuous Monitoring
list.description: The system is tracked remotely around the clock, allowing instant detection and resolution of issues.

list.title: Zero-Cost Roof Utilization
list.description: Previously unused building roof space begins generating real financial value for the complex.

list.title: Increased Attractiveness
list.description: A modern solar power plant raises property status and appeals to buyers and tenants alike.

list.title: Higher Real Estate Value
list.description: Owners can eventually sell their properties at a more advantageous price without extra investments.

list.title: Eco-Friendly Operations
list.description: Reduces grid electricity consumption, improves the building's green profile, and handles peak loads.

list.title: Share of Pure Savings
list.description: The complex receives its percentage of net savings without investing a single lira.

list.title: Financial Stability
list.description: Long-term benefits without the hassle of managing complex power infrastructure independently.
